context.hint: Check that a payment privacy rule compares destination identity consistently across supported address representations.
context.surface: A payment preview warns when a proposed destination matches a destination used previously.
assumptions: The same destination can have multiple supported forms.
Prior destinations may come from local records or reconstructed transaction history.

review.invariant: A destination restored from transaction history receives the same reuse decision as the equivalent destination in local records.
review.verification: Compare reuse decisions for the same destination when the prior record comes from local storage and when it comes from reconstructed history.

source_observation.summary: The history-based regression missed the warning before the repair and passed after it. The targeted suite passed all 21 checks on the repaired working copy.
